title: Implement PostgresStore with pgx/v5, ACID Optimistic Locking & Idempotent Seeding
description: Add github.com/jackc/pgx/v5 to services/deal-engine-go/go.mod and implement internal/store/postgres_store.go with pgxpool (MaxConns=25, MinConns=5, MaxConnLifetime=15m, pooler-safe query protocol), deterministic UUIDv5 + external_id mapping, ACID optimistic version CAS on escrow_contracts, append-only system_audit_vouchers preserving canonical JSON, all E-01..E-10 + webhook + telemetry tables, and idempotent ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING boot seeding.
acceptance_criteria: pgx/v5 added to go.mod and go.sum tidied
PostgresStore implements all StoreInterface methods with zero UUID syntax errors for string IDs like d_8821_juki and P-01..P-05
ApplyTransition uses PostgreSQL ACID transaction and WHERE deal_room_id = $2 AND version = $3 optimistic locking returning *fsm.ConflictError on stale version
system_audit_vouchers inserts are strictly append-only and preserve exact payload_json for ChainHash verification
Boot seeding is idempotent (ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING) and preserves mutated state across restarts
Unit and PostgresStore integration tests pass under go test -v -race ./...
